joint_verdict: Both A1 and B1 failed -- the third row of the registered decision table. The budget axis is CLOSED on all three corpora, and what remains is distractor removal.
what_this_settles: The context optimum is NOT a HiTab artifact. All three corpora have one, and CLAUDE.md's section generalizes rather than needing to be scoped.
The optimum sits at a DIFFERENT budget per corpus: HiTab 512-1024, RealHitBench 1024, AIT-QA at or below 512. AIT-QA is already past it at the budget every committed run used.
The budget lever is worth +.029 on RealHitBench (512->1024) and is negative everywhere else. It does not close the gap to HiTab's .604.

unregistered_observation.claim: the reading penalty tracks TABLES IN CONTEXT, and the same curve fits all three corpora -- NOT registered, 7 points, post hoc
unregistered_observation.why_it_matters: It says why AIT-QA cannot be helped by budget: at 512 it ALREADY carries 10.51 tables where HiTab carries 2.56. Its cells are short and its tables small, so a fixed budget pulls from ten tables at once. The lever there is fewer tables per context, not more tokens -- the same intervention the reading-ceiling section measured at +.104 on HiTab and which has never been run elsewhere.
unregistered_observation.caveat: Post hoc, 7 points, three corpora with different readers-per-run conditions held only within corpus. Do not cite as a result. It is the next registration.
